name: bgl_auto_leave_anniversary
script:
today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
periods = frappe.get_all('Leave Period', filters={'is_active': 1}, fields=['name', 'from_date', 'to_date', 'company'], order_by='from_date desc', limit_page_length=1)

if periods:
    p = periods[0]
    pname = p.get('name')
    pstart = p.get('from_date')
    pend = p.get('to_date')
    pcompany = p.get('company')

    # work out which policy is which for THIS period, from what is already assigned.
    # the policy carrying Maternity Leave is the women's policy.
    seen = []
    for a in frappe.get_all('Leave Policy Assignment', filters={'docstatus': 1, 'leave_period': pname}, fields=['leave_policy'], limit_page_length=0):
        if a.get('leave_policy') not in seen:
            seen.append(a.get('leave_policy'))
    w_pol = None
    m_pol = None
    for pol in seen:
        if frappe.db.exists('Leave Policy Detail', {'parent': pol, 'leave_type': 'Maternity Leave'}):
            w_pol = pol
        else:
            m_pol = pol

    emps = frappe.get_all('Employee', filters={'status': 'Active'}, fields=['name', 'employee_name', 'date_of_joining', 'gender'], limit_page_length=0)

    for e in emps:
        emp = e.get('name')
        doj = e.get('date_of_joining')
        if not doj:
            continue
        anniv = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.add_months(doj, 12))
        eligible = 0
        if anniv <= today:
            eligible = 1

        asg = frappe.get_all('Leave Policy Assignment', filters={'employee': emp, 'docstatus': 1, 'leave_period': pname}, fields=['leave_policy'], limit_page_length=1)

        created = 0
        if not asg:
            pol = m_pol
            if e.get('gender') == 'Female' and w_pol:
                pol = w_pol
            if not pol:
                continue
            la = frappe.new_doc('Leave Policy Assignment')
            la.employee = emp
            la.leave_policy = pol
            la.assignment_based_on = 'Leave Period'
            la.leave_period = pname
            la.effective_from = pstart
            la.effective_to = pend
            la.company = pcompany
            la.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            la.submit()
            created = 1
        else:
            pol = asg[0].get('leave_policy')

        allocs = frappe.get_all('Leave Allocation', filters={'employee': emp, 'docstatus': 1, 'from_date': pstart}, fields=['name', 'leave_type', 'new_leaves_allocated'], limit_page_length=0)
        for a in allocs:
            cur = float(a.get('new_leaves_allocated') or 0)
            # only act on a fresh assignment, or to top up a zero balance at the anniversary.
            # never touch an existing non-zero figure - it may be a deliberate manual adjustment.
            if created == 0 and cur != 0:
                continue
            target = 0.0
            if eligible:
                rows = frappe.get_all('Leave Policy Detail', filters={'parent': pol, 'leave_type': a.get('leave_type')}, fields=['annual_allocation'], parent='Leave Policy', limit_page_length=1)
                if not rows:
                    continue
                target = float(rows[0].get('annual_allocation') or 0)
            if abs(cur - target) < 0.005:
                continue
            d = frappe.get_doc('Leave Allocation', a.get('name'))
            d.new_leaves_allocated = target
            d.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            c = frappe.new_doc('Comment')
            c.comment_type = 'Comment'
            c.reference_doctype = 'Leave Allocation'
            c.reference_name = a.get('name')
            if eligible:
                c.content = 'Set automatically. Joined ' + str(doj) + ', completed one year of service ' + str(anniv) + '. ' + str(a.get('leave_type')) + ' set to ' + str(target) + ' per policy ' + str(pol) + '.'
            else:
                c.content = 'Set automatically. Joined ' + str(doj) + ', not yet one year of service. ' + str(a.get('leave_type')) + ' held at 0 until ' + str(anniv) + '.'
            c.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

name: bgl_leave_encashment_amount
script:
# BGL - Leave Encashment amount.
# ERPNext's built-in rate (Salary Structure > Leave Encashment Amount Per Day) is a single
# flat figure shared by everyone on the structure, which is wrong for BGL because basics vary.
# This computes it per employee instead: (SSA base / 22) x days encashed.
# 22 is BGL's working month and matches the Absent formula, so a leave day and an absent day
# are valued identically.
# Runs on Before Save, i.e. after the standard validate has set the amount to 0, so this wins.

STANDARD_DAYS = 22.0

days = frappe.utils.flt(doc.encashment_days)
if days <= 0:
    doc.encashment_amount = 0
else:
    as_of = doc.encashment_date or frappe.utils.nowdate()
    ssa = frappe.get_all(
        "Salary Structure Assignment",
        filters={
            "employee": doc.employee,
            "docstatus": 1,
            "from_date": ["<=", as_of],
        },
        fields=["base"],
        order_by="from_date desc",
        limit=1,
    )
    base = frappe.utils.flt(ssa[0].base) if ssa else 0

    if base <= 0:
        frappe.throw(
            "No submitted Salary Structure Assignment with a base was found for "
            + str(doc.employee_name or doc.employee)
            + " on or before "
            + str(as_of)
            + ". Encashment cannot be valued without it."
        )

    doc.encashment_amount = frappe.utils.flt((base / STANDARD_DAYS) * days, 2)

name: bgl_leave_status_after_submit
script:
# BGL - Leave Status, immediate refresh for one employee on submit.
emp = doc.employee
today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
horizon = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.add_days(today, 14))

apps = frappe.get_all(
    "Leave Application",
    filters={"docstatus": 1, "status": "Approved", "employee": emp, "to_date": [">=", today]},
    fields=["leave_type", "from_date", "to_date", "custom_resume_date"],
    order_by="from_date asc",
)

vals = {
    "custom_leave_status": "Available",
    "custom_current_leave_type": None,
    "custom_current_leave_from": None,
    "custom_return_to_work_date": None,
}

for a in apps:
    f = frappe.utils.getdate(a.from_date)
    t = frappe.utils.getdate(a.to_date)
    if f <= today <= t:
        st = "On Leave"
    elif today < f <= horizon:
        st = "Upcoming Leave"
    else:
        continue
    vals = {
        "custom_leave_status": st,
        "custom_current_leave_type": a.leave_type,
        "custom_current_leave_from": f,
        "custom_return_to_work_date": frappe.utils.getdate(a.custom_resume_date or frappe.utils.add_days(t, 1)),
    }
    break

frappe.db.set_value("Employee", emp, vals, update_modified=False)

name: bgl_leave_status_sync
script:
# BGL - Leave Status Sync
# Keeps Employee leave-status fields in step with approved Leave Applications.
# Stores the RETURN DATE, never a countdown, so the figure shown never goes stale.
# Runs silently. No emails, no tasks, no comments.

today = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
horizon = frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.add_days(today, 14))

apps = frappe.get_all(
    "Leave Application",
    filters={"docstatus": 1, "status": "Approved", "to_date": [">=", today]},
    fields=["employee", "leave_type", "from_date", "to_date", "custom_resume_date"],
    order_by="from_date asc",
)

state = {}
for a in apps:
    if a.employee in state:
        continue
    f = frappe.utils.getdate(a.from_date)
    t = frappe.utils.getdate(a.to_date)
    if f <= today <= t:
        st = "On Leave"
    elif today < f <= horizon:
        st = "Upcoming Leave"
    else:
        continue
    rtw = a.custom_resume_date or frappe.utils.add_days(t, 1)
    state[a.employee] = (st, a.leave_type, f, frappe.utils.getdate(rtw))

emps = frappe.get_all(
    "Employee",
    filters={"status": "Active"},
    fields=[
        "name",
        "custom_leave_status",
        "custom_current_leave_type",
        "custom_current_leave_from",
        "custom_return_to_work_date",
    ],
)

for e in emps:
    s = state.get(e.name)
    new_status = s[0] if s else "Available"
    new_type = s[1] if s else None
    new_from = s[2] if s else None
    new_rtw = s[3] if s else None

    cur_from = frappe.utils.getdate(e.custom_current_leave_from) if e.custom_current_leave_from else None
    cur_rtw = frappe.utils.getdate(e.custom_return_to_work_date) if e.custom_return_to_work_date else None

    changed = (
        (e.custom_leave_status or "Available") != new_status
        or (e.custom_current_leave_type or None) != new_type
        or cur_from != new_from
        or cur_rtw != new_rtw
    )

    if changed:
        frappe.db.set_value(
            "Employee",
            e.name,
            {
                "custom_leave_status": new_status,
                "custom_current_leave_type": new_type,
                "custom_current_leave_from": new_from,
                "custom_return_to_work_date": new_rtw,
            },
            update_modified=False,
        )

name: bgl_encashment_date_guard
script:
# BGL - Leave Encashment date guard. # An Additional Salary is only picked up by Payroll Entry when its payroll_date # falls INSIDE the period being run. Leave Encashment stamps the Additional # Salary with the Encashment Date, so a date in an already-run or far-future # month means the money never reaches a payslip. # Runs on Before Submit. Skipped when paying cash via Payment Entry. if not doc.pay_via_payment_entry: enc = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.encashment_date) m_start = frappe.utils.get_first_day(enc) m_end = frappe.utils.get_last_day(enc) # 1. payroll already run for that month? run = frappe.db.exists( "Salary Slip", {"employee": doc.employee, "docstatus": 1, "start_date": ["<=", enc], "end_date": [">=", enc]}, ) if run: frappe.throw( "Payroll for " + frappe.utils.formatdate(m_start, "MMMM yyyy") + " has already been run for " + str(doc.employee_name or doc.employee) + ", so this encashment can never be paid through it.

" + "Change the Encashment Date to a month whose payroll has not " + "been run yet (month-end is safest), or tick Pay Via Payment " + "Entry if the employee is being paid in cash now.", title="Payroll already run for this month", ) # 2. date in the past, before this month if m_end < frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate()): frappe.throw( "The Encashment Date is in a closed month (" + frappe.utils.formatdate(m_start, "MMMM yyyy") + "). Payroll Entry only picks up an Additional Salary whose date " + "falls inside the period being run.

" + "Use a date in the month you want this paid - normally the last " + "day of the current month.", title="Encashment Date is in a closed month", ) frappe.msgprint( "This encashment will be paid with the payroll run covering " + frappe.utils.formatdate(m_start, "MMMM yyyy") + " (Additional Salary dated " + frappe.utils.formatdate(enc) + ", GHS " + str(doc.encashment_amount) + ").

Run Payroll Entry for a period that includes this date, " + "or the amount will not appear on any payslip.", title="Encashment scheduled for payroll", indicator="blue", )
